events.body:
Two small changes landed on `main` during the branch cleanup without review. Please look at both and keep or change them.

## blt-owasp-wich: visual redesign

The compliance checker's visual redesign was landed from the branch `blt-owasp-wich/refactor/update-style` as [`f11afa8dc0`](https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT/commit/f11afa8dc05b433e89a48d41cf25ec30dcdbfac6). It is cosmetic only and was never merged upstream.

- [ ] Keep the redesign, or revert [`f11afa8dc0`](https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT/commit/f11afa8dc05b433e89a48d41cf25ec30dcdbfac6)

## blt-rewards: community footer links

The blt-rewards footer had placeholder "Discord" links with `href="#"`. [`7fc40d701b`](https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT/commit/7fc40d701be121e323f440b22919b7905511ec92) changed them to "Discussions", pointing at [git.owaspblt.org/BLT/discussions](https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT/discussions).

Alternatives:

- An official Discord invite. blt-newsletter's [`blt-newsletter/CONTRIBUTING.md`](https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT/blob/main/blt-newsletter/CONTRIBUTING.md) mentions [discord.gg/owasp-blt](https://discord.gg/owasp-blt), but that invite has not been verified.
- The [OWASP Slack](https://owasp.org/slack/invite).

- [ ] Keep "Discussions", or switch the footer to a verified Discord invite or the OWASP Slack
